title: Strategic Objective Onramp and Dependency Exchange
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: As multiple leadership teams spin up parallel initiatives against the same company-level OKRs, we lack a lightweight, repeatable intake that (1) captures assumptions and success metrics, (2) surfaces downstream dependencies early, and (3) provides a single exchange where teams can negotiate scope and delivery windows. Current state: ad-hoc meetings, siloed spreadsheets, and late discovery of infra/console/ops blockers. Goal: deliver a short, pragmatic 'Onramp & Exchange' playbook and lightweight tooling (1-pager + dependency board template) that reduces cross-team late-stage rework by 40% for Q2 rollouts. Deliverables: canonical intake template (Confluence one-pager), dependency-exchange cadence (weekly 30m), dependency board template (Linear+Miro), example completed intake for runtime-1.20 rollout. Success metrics: reduction in blockers logged during last two weeks of rollout window, time to resolution for cross-team blockers, and stakeholder satisfaction survey (target >= 4/5). Trade-offs considered: a heavy gated process would block velocity; a purely async Slack channel is noisy and unstructured. We choose a hybrid lightweight intake + weekly exchange cadence to balance speed and alignment.
acceptance_criteria: Published Confluence one-pager with template fields and examples
Dependency board template added to company Miro with owner fields and SLA expectations
Automated Linear view saved (PM filter) for tracking dependent issues across ENG/DES/OPS
Pilot run completed with runtime-1.20 and at least three partner teams (Infra, Console, Dedicated)
Baseline metrics captured and dashboard created in Looker for blocker count and MTTR
